definitions: Succeed in doing something, especially something difficult.
Be in charge of or organize (a business, establishment, or undertaking); run.
Succeed in surviving or achieving a satisfactory outcome in a particular situation.
Be able to cope with (a situation or a person).
Use or control (a resource or system).
examples: I managed to get to the top of the mountain.
She manages a team of twenty people.
How do you manage with three children?
He manages his finances very carefully.
